However, legal disputes persist from the City of Imperial and environmental advocates challenging its progression.

title: Steve Ballmer gave $10mn to restore LA courts; 350 projects completed 4 years later

The project successfully revamped 350 courts throughout the city, making them more accessible. The Clippers Community Courts project was completed on June 28, 2022, at the Michelle and Barack Obama Sports Center. The renovated courts have served multi-purpose functions during the Covid-19 pandemic, aiding the community.

title: Emilia Clarke's charity helps over 1,200 brain injury survivors in 7 years

With over £3.8 million raised, the initiative has positively impacted more than 1,200 lives. One of its key offerings, NeuroRehabilitation Online, utilizes teletherapy to connect patients with qualified therapists. By focusing on the crucial recovery phase post-hospital, SameYou strives to fill significant gaps in patient care, garnering accolades for its innovative support approaches.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35M mansion faces another property review

title: India shelves coal import plan as high global prices, weak rupee raise costs

Coal stockpiles have reached critically low levels at many power stations, prompting concerns about electricity shortages in the country. Policymakers are focusing on boosting domestic coal production and improving transportation to mitigate the situation.
